reviews.text: Don't be fooled by the pretty urns they provide for your pets this place was filthy dog pee all over the floor doctors,patients and nurses were stepping all in the pee carrying it all threw the clinic even after my wife told them it was pee on the floor we went to euthanize our cat and the service was bad nurses and staff was walking threw our room while we was trying to mourn the lost of our pet very disrespectful behavior.i wouldn't recommend this place to my worse enemy
Amazing from the ladies at the front, to the assistants and Doctors. Thank you all

I have been going to this veterinarian office for over a year now. One of the ongoing issues I am encountering is the consistent lateness with appointments. For example, during my last visit, I was scheduled for 1:15 p.m., but I was not seen until 2:15 p.m.

This continues to happen regularly. I have raised this concern with several staff members, but it has never been addressed. My time is incredibly valuable, and I am not interested in spending an entire hour waiting to be seen.
Horrible tech. Not helpful
Animal hospital of Morris Park were absolutely great with the care they provided for my kitty. I’m grateful for them and recommend them to my family and friends.
Overpriced & killed my dog & my neighbors dog with a specific injection both dogs were given being told they have “cancer” both dogs died days later

Hi Stephanie, thank you so much for your 5-star review! We truly appreciate your support and are grateful you took the time to rate your experience. Thank you for trusting us with your pet’s care. We’re so glad to have been able to provide a positive experience for you and your pet!
everyone is very helpful and courteous, great vet, good appointments scheduling

they put a muzzle on my dog without my authority. nope. they do not care about you or your dog. how are you giggling and laughing at the front desk when you're in an environment where animals and their owners are in distress? make it make sense .. veryyyy unprofessional establishment.

if you come in for a walk in the wait is over 2 hours but they won't be straight up and tell you that, when you go up to the front desk to ask how much longer they will lie to you and tell you that you're the first walk in.
Best Vets  and Staff in the Bronx! They truly care about our babies!

I felt unsupported during my visit at the clinic which was a crtical time for my dog. One of your providers was very dismissive towards my dog's illness and there was simply no accountability for his lack of concern towards my dog's medical situation.  I have not been back to the practice bc of this incident however there were some workers there that did demonstrate great work ethic and compassion, however my experience there rubbed me the wrong way so I can not subject my dog to this treatment again despite the convenience of the location.

I wish I knew how great this place is.
They’re such amazing people, Caring, compassion about what you go through
Unfortunately I lost my baby boy Rocco 8/20/26 weeks ago we’re able to stay for as long we wanted
From, Front desk to doctors, gave us full support.
100% Will recommend
I know if this would have been Rocco’s vet
He’d be alive today
Thank you Everyone at Morris park hospital
We appreciate you all
From, Elizabeth and Hector Gonzalez
By the way Rocco was a bull terrier male Caine

Hi Talika, thank you so much for your 5-star review! We’re so glad to hear you had a great experience with our team and found our prices reasonable. Providing friendly, attentive service and quality care for every pet is what we strive for each day. We truly appreciate your support and are grateful you took the time to share your feedback!

Horrible payment system practices and there is no empathy for nuance here. They don’t take any payment methods other than in person, so you are SOL for other ways of payment. Even after offering to fax, for a secure payment link, nothing satisfied their strict and ancient policies, so my out of state mother wasn’t allowed to help pay the over $2k estimate. They don’t care about you or your pet. They said to even make an appointment I had to come in to pay the deposit. Wouldn’t make the deposit over the phone. I’ve never even heard of such a thing. That’s how you know they’re janky.

Vet tech was short and dismissive at exam. I’ll be taking my cat elsewhere for kinder and more thoughtful care.

Staff was great.  Prices are ridiculous.
I have to look into pet insurance I guess.
Quality care ,affordable prices
Great service

BEWARE!!!!!!  There are plenty more animal hospitals/vets in this area to go to. Do yourself a favor and try them out first. Especially if your dog needs a Prescription. Very small clinic, definitely needs a cleaning and very inexperienced vet technicians. Not sure how anyone is giving this place five stars but you might want to consider other options. One thing they’re good at that I must say is overcharging. They clearly take advantage of your love and a kind heartedness for your pet. It sucks that you have to at least give one star because this place would get none.

Just responding to you because I read your response, yes, I’m in your system. I stopped going to you because I found a much better vet who does not take advantage of people for their love of animals. It’s the Triboro vet clinic. They’re very reasonable and they don’t take advantage of your love for animals. I’m in your system. But then again, maybe you removed me because I called you out on your price gouging
Hi Maria, thank you for your 5-star review! We truly appreciate your support and are grateful you took the time to rate your experience. Thank you for trusting us with your pet's care!

The veterinarian hospital is always attentive, sensitive and supportive to the needs of the client. They even do follow up appointments and call backs to check on the care of your furry family member. I love this place and have been using them for over 18 years.

I have been taking my dog here since he was born. My dog developed allergies a year ago.Initially they told me he had an ear infection, I pay over $500 for medication, exam and other fees. I had to take him back 3x since then and charged over $2000 in total. Everytime I go there the Vet, a south Asian lady, kept adding a bunch of test to my bill and things I did not ask for nor we spoke about, I had to ask what individual things were. My dog was prescribed multiple pills each visits, he got shots etc and nothing seems to work. They took samples from my dog twice and yet to tell me any results. This place is horrible and don’t know what they are doing. They need to stick to annual vaccines only.

Although I had to make the decision to put my baby to rest, the experience at the vet was pleasant. No long waits. I received the ashes in a very nice urn and packaging with a thoughtful card. I recommend this place for your first babies.
Professional and Friendly, Thank you to all !! Will definitely be recommending this veterinarian to family and friends

Hi Kenneth, thank you so much for your 4-star review. We truly appreciate your support and the opportunity to care for your pet. Our team is committed to providing compassionate, high-quality care and creating a positive experience for every pet and family we serve.
Hi Abelino, thank you for your 5-star review! We truly appreciate your support and are grateful you took the time to rate your experience. Thank you for trusting us with your pet's care.

STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE!!! Our 4 month old  puppy ate rocks and this place said she needed surgery right away and were going to charge us $5000+. It was on a Saturday.  I was finally able to get in touch with our vet and was told to NEVER go to this place and to get our puppy out of there. We got her out in time and took her to Guardian Emergency Vet and they told us she only had to be watched. $3500 less and no need for surgery.

Hi Mari, thank you so much for the 4-star review! We truly appreciate your support and are so glad we had the opportunity to care for your pet. We are always dedicated to providing the best possible care and experience for every pet and family we serve. Thank you for trusting us with your pet's care.
Location is a bit pricey but I had no issue paying because the service to my baby was great! They called me to make sure how my cat was doing after her spay 😊

Good experience like always, Dr. Halty and technician were wonderful. It was Great to see Dr. Halty, he has been my two cats doctor since they were babies, Cleo La Tigera 19yr and Bendicion 6yrs. Thank u for taking care of my Children my Angels.

The staff was very kind and professional, showing great empathy especially when we had to put out pet of 14 years to sleep, they called and checked on her during the process, and that meant alot to my family.
